subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should Feishu source-message recall be an unconditional cancellation signal for all source-bound single-agent and broadcast runs, including suppressing their final replies?
rationale: The code can implement either policy, but whether a recalled user message revokes already-started work authorization is a channel product and user-expectation decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve recall-as-cancellation
options.body: Accept the plugin-owned behavior after exact-head live proof confirms that recalled single-agent and broadcast runs abort without delivering replies.

options.title: Scope cancellation more narrowly
options.body: Limit cancellation to selected conversation modes or dispatch stages if group/broadcast recall semantics should retain existing work.

options.title: Pause for cross-channel policy
options.body: Keep this Feishu implementation unmerged until the broader recall-cancellation direction is decided for channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve recall-as-cancellation
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-owned behavior after exact-head live proof confirms that recalled single-agent and broadcast runs abort without delivering replies.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current implementation context and can supply the requested exact-head evidence, while a Feishu-area reviewer should make the final policy choice.
